mapper.select: SELECT a.dcr05_doc_type_id AS doc_type_id, a.dcr05_company_id AS company_id, a.dcr05_title AS title, a.dcr05_content AS content, a.dcr05_note AS note, a.dcr05_doc_form_class_cd AS doc_form_class_code, b.sys09_name AS doc_form_class_name FROM dcr05_doc_type a INNER JOIN ( SELECT c.* FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code c ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'DocFormClassCode' AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT MAX(sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code WHERE sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys09_code = c.sys09_code AND sys09_apply_date <= f_today() ) ) b ON b.sys09_code = a.dcr05_doc_form_class_cd WHERE a.dcr05_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.dcr05_doc_form_class_cd LIKE #{formClassCode} AND UPPER(CONCAT(a.dcr05_title, a.dcr05_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{titleName}) ORDER BY COALESCE(LPAD(b.sys09_seq,3,'0'),'000'), b.sys09_code, a.dcr05_title

SELECT a.dcr05_doc_type_id AS doc_type_id, a.dcr05_company_id AS company_id, a.dcr05_title AS title, a.dcr05_content AS content, a.dcr05_note AS note, a.dcr05_doc_form_class_cd AS doc_form_class_code, ( SELECT c.sys09_name FROM sys08_code_kind INNER JOIN sys09_code c ON sys09_code_kind_id = sys08_code_kind_id AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} WHERE sys08_kind_cd = 'DocFormClassCode' AND c.sys09_code = a.dcr05_doc_form_class_cd ORDER BY c.sys09_apply_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS doc_form_class_name FROM dcr05_doc_type a WHERE a.dcr05_doc_type_id = #{docTypeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dcr05_doc_type (dcr05_doc_type_id, dcr05_company_id, dcr05_title, dcr05_content, dcr05_note, dcr05_doc_form_class_cd) VALUES (#{docTypeId}, #{companyId}, #{req.title}, #{req.content}, #{req.note}, #{req.docFormClassCode})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dcr06_relate_doc_type INNER JOIN dcr05_doc_type ON dcr05_doc_type_id = dcr06_doc_type_id WHERE dcr06_doc_type_id = #{docTypeId}
